Theorem
[surface Ricci-flow differential Harnack estimate] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 2.5.2\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates Let $g_{ij}(x,t)$ be a complete solution of the Ricci flow on a surface $M$. Assume the scalar curvature of the initial metric is bounded, nonnegative everywhere and positive somewhere. Then the scalar curvature $R(x,t)$ satisfies the Li-Yau estimate \be \frac{\partial R}{\partial t} - \frac{|\nabla R|^2}{R} + \frac{R}{t} ≥0.\ee

Proof

↗ lem:cz-tensor-maximum-principle-on-complete-manifolds \sketch Apply the tensor maximum principle to the surface Harnack quantity using the scalar-curvature evolution.
